status: Native Lens Correction workflow implemented with focused Debug qualification. Complete F05/Photoshop parity remains open. Optimized/universal qualification is batched with the remaining F05 workspaces.
scope: Lens distortion, red/cyan and blue/yellow fringe, profile/custom vignette, perspective, rotation, scale/autoscale and edge modes; native preview/distortion/straighten/grid/pan/zoom/settings/history; editable Smart Filters/native30; typed API and existing recorded Actions/Batch.

primary_references.note: Native manual controls follow documented semantics, including lower vignette midpoint affecting more area. Rust source used the opposite midpoint direction.

primary_references.finding: No dedicated lens route or qualified typed lensCorrection descriptor. Unqualified actionJSON rejects explicitly.

photato_api.state: Strict settings/default/schema, generic estimator and custom profile coefficients, native draft settings/tool/preview/grid/zoom/effective scale/history and busy availability. Same engine/transactions/selection/locks and undo. Actions/batch are existing shared routes, not new commands.

adobe_api.scope: Unqualified lensCorrection actionJSON and editable PSD/PSB descriptors reject explicitly. No Adobe operation was invented. Existing rendered raster exports and other qualified jobs remain.

menus.unbound: File > Automate > Lens Correction… remains unbound. Lens actions can already run through the native Batch workspace and API.

qualification: 97 focused Debug tests pass on current source. Optimized/full regression and universal packaging are batched at the F05 family milestone; the current packaged candidate remains step185 and does not include Lens Correction.

tests.independent_evidence: Analytically derived Rust geometry coordinates, chromatic mapping, perspective ordering, straighten angle, bounded autoscale and Adobe-documented midpoint direction. All-depth identity/selection/locks/history, strict parsing, native30/source retention, transformed Smart Object coordinates, native model/Cancel, HTTP and Actions/Batch agreement. No independent Photoshop pixel oracle.
tests.offscreen_limit: Image/controls are captured; native buttons incompletely render offscreen. No live pointer/keyboard or exact visual qualification.

limitations: Exact Adobe pixels, resampling/edge/colour behavior and physical macOS14/Intel/macOS26/live qualification remain open. Last desktop evidence remains locked; no bypass/re-probe.

Manufacturer calibration database, online profile retrieval, EXIF camera/lens matching, Adobe LCP settings/profile interchange, remembered lens defaults and previous-conversion settings remain open. Custom coefficients and labelled generic estimates are distinct native capabilities.

Native RGB8/16 uses encoded samples; RGB32 linear support is a Photato extension. The native editor does not yet reproduce the entire Photoshop grayscale/CMYK/Lab document/filter matrix. Existing8,388,608-source-pixel limit remains.
Smart Object preview resolves post-placement/prior-filter input geometry. Arbitrary later geometry filters, complex mask/warp combinations and exact interactive tool mapping remain unqualified.
Autoscale samples41 positions on each border for all three colour maps and caps800%; it is a bounded approximation. It can reject extreme transformations instead of claiming coverage.
Native preset files use JSON, not Adobe settings interchange. Grid/pan/zoom are presentation state; clients implement their own view while consuming the same native correction settings.
File > Automate > Lens Correction has no dedicated native preset dialog yet. Existing Actions/Batch handles lens filter programs and is tested through desktop/API.
Editable PSD/PSB Lens Correction and Adobe actionJSON descriptors remain unsupported. Native30 preserves editability; rendered/raster exports are available.

All97 focused Debug tests pass; current optimized/full/universal validation is deferred to the F05 family milestone. Latest packaged candidate is step185 and excludes Lens Correction. Full F05 remains open.
next: Adaptive Wide Angle, then Vanishing Point. Continue major breadth and batch full/optimized/universal qualification at the F05 milestone.

later_family_qualification.note: Later family batch includes Lens Correction, Adaptive Wide Angle and Vanishing Point. Earlier milestone records remain historical. Exact/live/platform parity remains open.
